answer: Make each new agent identity post a refundable stake locked for 30 days, sized so that a thousand fake accounts cost a thousand times the stake. Stake alone is cheap for rich attackers, so voting weight grows with the square root of stake and with age. Any identity that a random audit finds colluding, such as an ocean of accounts sharing one funding source, forfeits its stake. Honest agents lose only the interest. Like saffron, trust is costly per gram, so a crystal-clear audit trail makes slashing credible.
